result.topic_en: Integral representations of the digamma function and of log Π(s) (log Gamma), with a derivation of Stirling's constant ½ log 2π via the Wallis product and the sine product formula.
result.transcription:

methods.what: Series and integral representation of the digamma function difference
Integral representation for log Gamma (Binet's first formula form)
Stirling-type formula for log Π s with constant ½ log 2π
Value of the integral giving Stirling's constant
Product formula for sine and reflection formula
Wallis product in factorial form used to determine the Stirling constant
Asymptotic evaluation of the logarithm of the Wallis identity to determine the constant C
